card.name: Permanent before discontinuation, or consent wording
card.fires_on: The word "permanent" (or "permanently") right before "discontinuation"/"discontinued" in adverse-reaction summaries. Also "give" in "ability to give informed consent".

modes.label: Permanent discontinuation
modes.description: "permanent" or "permanently" just before discontinuation of a drug after a reaction.
modes.example: Hyperthyroidism led to<< permanent>> discontinuation of intravenous pembroliz
